headline: On ‘Slow Horses,’ Kristin Scott Thomas’s Diana Taverner Is in Charge at Last
context: Kristin Scott Thomas gives a morally gray tinge to “Lady Di” Taverner, who takes over as head of Britain’s MI5 secret service in Season 6.
